== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ホス：エコー基地医務室</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">1ターンに1回、自分の医療用ドロイドを1台、-2で配備できる。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しており、この場所に帝国軍がいるなら、フォース消耗に＋1。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Hoth: Echo Med Lab.

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

No lore box. Light lets you deploy one medical droid at -2. English reduces one medical droid's deploy cost by 2. Dark needs an Imperial at this location. Icons match: 1 Light Force, 0 Dark Force, Underground, Interior, Planet, Scomp Link.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-hothechomedlab-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Hoth: Echo Med Lab]].</ref>
